headline: Senate advances procedurally on tax relief bill while House powers through nuclear energy and veterans benefits!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate voted 73-25 to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to H.R. 2347, the Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act, clearing the way for continued debate. Senators also passed S. 3589, the RISE Act, providing information access for students with disabilities, and agreed to S. Res. 952 authorizing use of Hart Senate Atrium on November 18 for Alexander Calder's sculpture commemoration.

onTheFloor.title: Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act - excludes sexual abuse damages from taxable income
RISE Act - provides disability students and families college selection information
Authorizes Hart Senate Atrium use for Calder sculpture event

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed five bipartisan nuclear energy and veterans bills by wide margins under suspension of rules. H.R. 3978 modernizing nuclear fuel reprocessing passed 397-2, H.R. 9612 updating uranium enrichment licensing passed 394-3, and H.R. 8552 boosting veterans disability compensation passed without opposition. Two additional nuclear measures saw debate postponed for further consideration.

onTheFloor.title: Nuclear REFUEL Act - modernizes definition of nuclear fuel production facilities
American Enrichment Deployment Act - updates uranium enrichment facility licensing
Nuclear Advisory Committee Reform Act - updates Advisory Committee on Reactor Safeguards role
NRC Staff Pay Alignment Act - provides compensation authority for NRC career appointees
Veterans Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act - increases disability compensation effective December 1, 2026
Efficient Nuclear Licensing Hearings Act - streamlines hearings on nuclear facility applications
Department of Energy Nuclear Transparency Act - increases transparency on DOE nuclear authorizations
Retirement Fairness for Charities and Educational Institutions Act - enhances 403(b) plans
